desc:
🎵 Make music. Post it. Go viral.

Produce your own songs in a full music studio, drop them into an endless scrolling feed, and watch the world react. Like, comment, follow, and climb the charts.

🎹 Two ways to make a beat

Piano Roll: a full 88-key editor. Place notes, stack chords, drag to resize, set the BPM, and even layer multiple instruments in one song.
Live Play: jump on the QWERTY piano and record a take in real time, exactly as you play it.
📱 A feed built for music
Scroll a personalized "For You" feed that learns your taste and surfaces songs you'll actually like. Follow your favorite creators, save tracks, and never run out of new sounds.

🌈 Pick your vibe
Every song gets a visualizer — Tiles, Orbit, or Bounce — so your track looks as good as it sounds.

💛 Get heard
Earn coins by posting, getting likes, and playing. Spend them to promote your songs to more people or gift the creators you love.

Create it. Share it. Blow up. 🚀
